purpose: Test a genuinely independent, reconstructible session-VWAP reclaim/retest entry source with sufficient natural event density, without importing prior-trade state or retuning exits.

source_basis.source: TradingView open source — VWAP Rejection Strategy XAUUSD
source_basis.logic: Gold-specific VWAP rejection/reaction is used as an intraday entry reference.
Mechanical sequence: reclaim by completed close, retest/hold of VWAP, then later trigger beyond the retest candle.

source_basis.source: MetaQuotes — Building an Object-Oriented Session VWAP Engine in MQL5
source_basis.logic: Session-reset VWAP as an intraday fair-value baseline; warns early-session accumulation is unstable.

source_basis.source: MetaQuotes — Decoding Opening Range Breakout Intraday Trading Strategies
source_basis.logic: Reconstructible VWAP trend-following example enters by completed-bar relationship to VWAP.

data_semantics.price: P75 synthetic Coinexx-like bid/ask derived from canonical Dukascopy ticks
data_semantics.vwap_weight: Each source tick contributes one observation; session VWAP is cumulative arithmetic mean of tick mid2 from the selected civil-session anchor. No unavailable exchange volume is invented.
data_semantics.causality: VWAP value for a completed M1 bar uses ticks only through that bar close. Entry decision occurs only after the completed retest/trigger bar.
data_semantics.session_reset: UTC day anchor; first 30 completed M1 bars are warmup/no proposals to avoid unstable early-session denominator.

R037-SVR-C01_RECLAIM_RETEST.rule: M1 close crosses from below to above session VWAP for long (inverse short); within next 5 completed M1 bars, price touches VWAP and closes back on reclaimed side; propose at retest close.

R037-SVR-C02_RECLAIM_RETEST_TRIGGER.rule: As C01, but require a later completed M1 close beyond the retest candle high for long / low for short within 3 bars; propose at trigger close.

R037-SVR-C03_REJECTION.rule: After at least 30 completed session minutes, M1 bar crosses through VWAP intrabar but closes back on the original side; propose in rejection direction at that close.

R037-SVR-C04_TWO_CLOSE_ACCEPT_RETEST.rule: Require two consecutive completed M1 closes on the new VWAP side after cross, then a VWAP touch that closes on that same side within 5 bars; propose at retest close.

screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss
